name: Iluvatar CoreX Tiangai 100 (BI-V100) training accelerator card product page
notes: PRIMARY VENDOR SOURCE. Model BI-V100: 7 nm general-GPU architecture, 32 GB HBM2, 250 W board power, PCIe Gen4 x16, 64 GB/s bidirectional host bandwidth AND 64 GB/s device-to-device interconnect bandwidth, full-height full-length dual-slot passive card, 169.5 mm class. Released March 2021 after four years of development. Vendor claims support for 200+ AI models and competitive average performance across 100+ benchmark models, but publishes NO throughput number. Software is DeepSpark.
